/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/retrieval-plan.json')
r=json.loads(p.read_text())
c=json.load(open('/tmp/r001-runtime.json'))['context']
assert set(r)=={'query','question','evidence_refs','requested_card_ids','missing_information'}
assert all(isinstance(r[k],str) and r[k] for k in ['query','question'])
assert all(isinstance(r[k],list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in r[k]) for k in ['evidence_refs','requested_card_ids','missing_information'])
assert set(r['evidence_refs']) <= set(c['allowed_observation_ids'])
pool={h['id']:h for h in c['history']}
a=lambda i: pool[i]['validation']['auc']
chron=a('r0011-history_adjacent')-a('r0012-history_half_bridge')
rank=a('r0012-scale_adjacent')-a('r0012-scale_half')
cap=c['protocol']['trial_cap_seconds']
reserve=21*cap+2*c['protocol']['estimated_unit_seconds']
print('Valid JSON; required fields and all 14 trial references verified.')
print('AUC adjacent-minus-half:',chron,rank,'interaction:',rank-chron)
print('Budget after one block and reserves:',c['remaining_seconds']-6*cap-reserve)
print('Budget after two blocks and reserves:',c['remaining_seconds']-12*cap-reserve)
print('Output:',str(p))
PY"
